prompts.text: # Fix a failing AXF Dev Console systems check: git push from the VPS checkout The console's systems check reported this, and its automatic fix failed. Fix the cause, then re-check. - Check id: `git-push` (service github, status error) - What it says: The VPS checkout can't push: GitHub refused its credentials. - How the fix failed: The check runs inside `axf-console` (checkout mounted at `/axf`), and the helper binary isn't in that container. Next: find where the helper gets configured. Details: - /usr/local/bin/axf-git-cred get: 1: /usr/local/bin/axf-git-cred: not found - /usr/local/bin/axf-…
